people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
translations.bsb: For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah, a tribe as to which Moses said nothing about priests.
translations.kjv: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
translations.asv: For it is evident that our Lord hath sprung out of Judah; as to which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priests.
